bugs_found: loan_payment uses (1+r)^(m-1)-1 denominator instead of (1+r)^m-1, causing wrong payments and division by zero for 1-month loans
compound_interest silently truncates fractional years and compounds_per_year via int(), changing financial results without validation
loan_payment silently truncates fractional months via int() instead of rejecting non-integer terms
transfer does not normalize/validate amount as Decimal/finite, allowing type errors or NaN/Infinity edge cases in balance mutations

money functions generally lack finite-value validation for Decimal NaN/Infinity inputs, allowing silent invalid outputs or inconsistent exceptions
compound_interest accepts negative principal without validation
apply_fee can return a negative net amount when minimum fee exceeds amount
